verdict.rationale: Aleph's own materials claim headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, ERP and spreadsheet data. That is a first-party capability for this story, but a single thin mention; separately, the docs claim versioned forecasts. Nothing documents role-level granularity, reconciliation to payroll actuals, or planned hires flowing into the expense forecast. Missing for 10: role-level headcount modeling, explicit tie-out to payroll actuals, documented flow of planned hires into the expense forecast, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
